lines.text: The psalmist loves the LORD because He heard his plea, and when the ropes of death entangled him, he called on the LORD.
The LORD delivered his soul from death, his eyes from tears, and his feet from stumbling.
In his alarm he said, "All men are liars!"
He will lift the cup of wrath and fulfill his vows to the LORD in the presence of all His people.
He will offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving and keep his vows in the courts of the LORD's house, in the midst of Samaria.
